title: Art. 9.25 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 9 - Passenger Data Exchange Systems, D. Passenger Name Record (PNR), 9.25
content:
Contracting States shall, with full respect for human rights and fundamental freedoms:

a) clearly identify in their legal and administrative framework the PNR data to be used in their operations;
b) clearly set the purposes for which PNR data may be used by the authorities, which should be no wider than that necessary in view of the aims to be achieved, including in particular border security purposes to fight terrorism and serious crime; and
c) limit the disclosure of PNR data to other authorities in the same State or in other Contracting States that exercise functions related to the purpose for which PNR data are processed, including in particular border security purposes, and ensure comparable protections as those afforded by the disclosing authority.
